citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
Copies of the last two semiannual reports signed by a majority of the IACUC were not available for review at time of
inspection. The last semiannual report available during inspection was conducted in May 2025, but was unsigned. Every
six months, upon completion of the program review and facility inspection, the IACUC must provide reports of its
evaluations to the Institutional Official to ensure that they are aware of the current status of the animal program, facilities,
and procedures. After completing the program review and the inspection of the animal facilities, the IACUC must prepare
reports of their evaluations that a majority of members must sign, and submit the reports to the Institutional Official.
Correct by next semiannual review.

It has been more than a year since the last annual review of the contingency plan. The last recorded review was in
"February 2023". An annual review of the contingency plan helps ensure that any needed changes are made and
communicated to all personnel that have a role or responsibilities in the plan to help avoid animal discomfort, illness,
injury or death in the event of an emergency or disaster. The registrant must ensure that the contingency plan is reviewed
on at least an annual basis to confirm that it adequately addresses the criteria listed in Section 2.38(l)(1) and must also
maintain documentation of those reviews, to include any amendments or changes made to the plan since the previous
year's review.
Correct by 20 October 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
